ana: heads-up: we flipped on the new Microburst Smoother (MBS) in gradual rollout for conv-default pools. :tada:
ana: quick metrics from canary: p50 -18%, p95 -9%, token cost -7.4% on chat-medium workload.
kevin: awesome. any regression signals?
ops-bot: canary MBS-2025-02 completed: pass. No infra errors; error rate delta 0.02%.
sre-lead: noted a small p99 uptick (+3%) for very high token sequences (>10k). adding a p99 alert group.
ana: expected tradeoff: smoothing reduces microburst-induced context switching, saves GPU cycles, but slightly delays extremely long tails. plan: enable by default but provide opt-out via route: `microburst_smoother: off`.
release-bot: rollout recorded: rollout/MBS-gradual by ana at 2025-02-14T08:10:00Z.
kevin: can you drop a one-paragraph bench note for finance? mention ~7% token cost drop and p50 improvement.
ana: will do. thanks everyone. :rocket:
